developmentFeedback: Discovery now prioritizes repository models for precise lifecycle/Joern/TLA requests while ordinary tracing retains its existing tools
Short method ids preserve native ids in full evidence
A one-call own-source check avoids stopping after derivation
Copied API requests retain exact chat/principal headers; next-state navigation scrolls to its target; graph and dark-editor contrast corrected
limits: Finite graph/TLC checks do not prove source equivalence, guard/value semantics, synchronized inter-machine behavior or liveness
OpenTelemetry overlays are opt-in sampled and chat-scoped; source digest must match before observations count as hits
External Joern method models remain static-only; no automatic external runtime trace correlation is claimed
Small-model evaluation is two bounded fixture conversations, not a general capability benchmark
Optional/live integration skips remain explicit in the full test report
